'''Zissh''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Zissh system/Legends|Zissh system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a frozen world where [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aven Rolk]] planned to establish a new [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and rebuild the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, his proclamation drew the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and Rolk was later found [[Death/Legends|dead]] in an ice cave.<ref name="RECG" />
